messages:
pagerduty: 🚨 INCIDENT: gcp-eu-south1 - GPU quota exhausted. Autoscaler failing to allocate GPUs, job queue growing. Pager level: P1
ops-bot: Alert summary: autoscale.attach errors = 412 in last 5m, last error = QUOTA_EXCEEDED (403). Affected pools: inference-prod-eu-south1. See logs: https://logs.example.com/9401234567
dan_oncall: oncall here, joining. Observed queue backlog ~2300 requests, tail latency 18s. Starting triage.
alice.chen: confirmed. Autoscaler is hitting GCP project GPU quota; allocation requests are denied. We should: 1) enable cross-region fallback routing, 2) scale down non-critical batch jobs in eu-south1, 3) downgrade some inference routes to cpu-fallback / smaller model until quota clears.
ben_g: pushing CPU fallback for low-priority routes now: `POST /v1/route/update {route: "batch-embeddings", model: "embed-small-cpu"}` — applying in 30s.
carmen_ops: kicked off job-scaler to drain batch workers: `kubectl scale deployment batch-workers --replicas=0 -n prod-eu-south1` (rolling). ETA drain 2m.
frank_sre: I can flip routing to eu-west1 for critical customers if capacity available. Checking warm pools in eu-west1.
ops-bot: autoscaler log snippet: ```2026-03-17T10:11:02Z autoscaler: request N=16 GPUs -> allocate returned 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED project:proj-redwood-eu region:eu-south1```
alice.chen: frank, please confirm warm pool capacity and whether models are pinned. If pinned, use compatible variant (quantized) for failover.
frank_sre: eu-west1 warm pool has ~120 GPUs free but some are reserved for Dedicated customers. Can route up to 80 GPUs for hosted fallback without SLA breach. Need approval to reroute.
dan_oncall: approve reroute of up to 60 GPUs to eu-west1 for 15m window to relieve queue. Carmen/Ben start redirect rules.
carmen_ops: redirect rule applied: `traffic_policy.set({from:eu-south1, fallback_region:eu-west1, max_gpus:60})` — will take effect in ~45s.
ben_g: CPU fallback applied for batch routes. Observed immediate drop in queue for batch routes (–600).
alice.chen: also enable prefix KV cache warmup for chat routes to reduce model compute: `cache.ingest --route chat-prod --prefixes recent-1k`
ops-bot: Paging external: opened GCP support case 23456789, severity=production-impacting. Contact assigned: gcp-support-eu. ETA initial response ~15m.
dan_oncall: starting a short bridge to coordinate with FR/infra folks — meet.google.com/rdw-bridge (call in 2m). Join: @frank_sre @alice.chen @carmen_ops @ben_g.
pagerduty: Incident created: INC-20260317-9401234567. Channel: #incidents. Bridge link attached.
support_bot: Customer-impact summary: ~3% of API requests are returning 429/503 due to queue timeouts; high-traffic customers X and Y may see degraded throughput. Support page notified.
alice.chen: mitigation status: 1) batch routes downgraded — done. 2) redirect to eu-west1 — in progress. 3) CPU fallback enabled — done. 4) emergency quota request filed — done.
frank_sre: reroute completed, traffic shifted ~48 GPUs to eu-west1. Queue total dropped from 2300 -> 900 in 3m. Tail latency back to ~6s.
ben_g: continuing to monitor. Alert thresholds still on for queue >500.
carmen_ops: initiated autoscaler cooldown to avoid thrash: cooldown=300s.
alice.chen: note — some Dedicated customer capacity reservations prevented using full eu-west1 pool. Follow-up: propose Dedicated carveout review in postmortem.
ops-bot: Runbook check: invoked runbook `gpu_quota_exhaustion` step 1..6. Current step: cross-region fallback applied.
dan_oncall: can we get an estimate from GCP on quota increase time? ops-bot said ~15m for initial response, but need uplift longer-term.
ops-bot: GCP support case update: initial response received, engineer asking for recent allocation request IDs and project billing verification.
frank_sre: uploaded allocation logs and request IDs to support case. Requested temporary quota bump to meet immediate demand.
alice.chen: next actions: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) if queue < 200 for 15m and no new errors, start ramp down cross-region fallback to reduce cross-region cost, 3) file postmortem and customer comms draft.
ben_g: monitoring dashboards attached: https://dash.example.com/d/infra/gpu-alloc?org=redwood&incident=9401234567
pagerduty: Reminder: if GCP support cannot provide uplift within 60m, escalate to cloud-ops lead for contract-level request.
carmen_ops: scaling batch-workers back to normal gradually; keeping CPU fallbacks active for 20m.
frank_sre: confirming customer X reported reduced error rate. Support to follow up with customers after incident ends.
dan_oncall: handoff at 10:45 UTC to evening oncall @frank_sre. Documented in incident ticket.
alice.chen: thanks team — bridge ended, we have mitigation in place. Postmortem owner: @alice.chen. ETA postmortem draft within 48h. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: autoscaler allocations succeed after reroute and quota case update. Final queue: 120 requests. Closing incident thread."
